verdicts.reason: The two candidates look the same. Both share these flaws: the body copy is tiny and unreadable at banner size, and it sits to the left of the headline, so it is read first and the reading order is backwards. The pink brush stroke has come away from the headline and now floats under the body copy, with a stray copy of it out at the right edge. The brick photo is cut down to a thin sliver, and the crane photo has shrunk to a meaningless grey speck. This breaks fidelity to the original's two-image layout and leaves the right third of the banner empty and unbalanced.
